        self.seq += 1

        self.error = None

    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        """Only the latest begun request can update rows, once.
        Older or duplicate replies return False."""
        if request_id != self.last_request_id:
            return False
        if request_id in self.finished_request_ids:
            return False
        
        self.rows = rows
        self.loading = False
        self.finished_request_ids.add(request_id)
